ambiguities: PRB-004: FOC-1 puts focus on the place title after the clicked button disappears. It is not stated whether the place title counts as the 'same part' re-shown, nor whether focus is moved at all.
PRB-013: WEB-6 says the focus stop comes after "Select all" of its column. The next Tab stop after the Backlog focus stop is read as "Select all in Ready".

PRB-023: carry-to counts cards 'whose middle is above the pointer'. It does not say whether a pointer exactly at the middle counts as above, nor how layout shifts during the drag change the counts. Both readings give position 3.
PRB-015: Shift+"x" is read as Shift+X. The text does not say whether the plain "x" first moves the selection for the focused card.
PRB-049: 'history depth after Back' is read as the entry count (unchanged at +1), per SCN-NAV-1.
PRB-005: whether the board data has arrived (400 ms) by the time Retry is clicked is only implied by FIX-11 latency; I read it as arrived, so the card shows Ready.
PRB-009: NAV-1 says dropped filter values are removed when the board data is loaded, but not whether the address is shown in the interim in a different form.
